name: onyx
description: Onyx, the native iOS/watchOS app. This package holds the code generators and the version single source of truth; the app itself is under native/.

scripts.check: npm run version:check && npm run check:types && npm run check:body && npm run check:atlas && npm run check:mirror && npm run check:doms && npm run check:report && npm run swift:ui && npm run check:watch
scripts.check:watch: xcodebuild build -project native/Onyx.xcodeproj -scheme OnyxWatch -destination 'platform=watchOS Simulator,name=Apple Watch Ultra 2 (49mm)' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -derivedDataPath "$HOME/Library/Caches/onyx-swift/check-watch"
scripts.native:gen: npm run version:sync && cd native && xcodegen generate
